remaining_completion_requirement: Finish actual source→exemplar native/UI acceptance→author→final review smoke and final integrated regression suite. No restart-readiness claim until those results are inspected.

rows.verification: Read the active instruction closure against original audit. Topic-specific remedies are conditional; historical campaign rules explicitly historical; fixed constraints concern learner work/cues, and capture belongs to runner. Live semantic controls preserve necessary unfamiliar-unit givens and reject extra hard tasks.
rows.limits: Instruction consistency and demonstrated judgments do not guarantee future model interpretation.

rows.verification: Live translated-bank and rank-collision pairs; independent qualifier pair; normal-constructor source-supported math/policy controls. Old exact-bank replay does not dictate future domain or answer roles.
rows.limits: Canonical inverse domain controls deliberately remove exact-task exclusions; they do not authorize serving imported duplicates.

rows.area: Preserve target work across authored bands
rows.verification: All final survivor records must map to same-band material-family representatives, every source step and response field accounted for. Give-u, missing-easy trig and held-out rectangle/unit controls distinguish reduced arithmetic from supplied decisions and added skills.
rows.limits: Difficulty bands remain authored judgments, not empirically calibrated levels. Family definitions and preservation are independently reviewed judgments, not inferred from schema.

rows.area: Shortcut evidence without new balance mandates
rows.verification: Live invariant-minimum bank rejected, post-hoc two-item same-rank diagnostic accepted. Evidence distinguishes discovery/confirmation/invariant/finite-pool claims; duplicate-byte discovery/confirmation guard. Small valid same-family/rank fragment passes scoped policy while malformed power pattern fails.
rows.limits: No finite audit proves absence of all cues. Confirmation applicability remains semantic judgment.

rows.verification: Record/field identities, shown endpoint versus actual key and explicit conversion assessment required. Live unshown parity change rejected; matching shown form accepted. Direct matrix-answer workflow must not invent CAS negative controls.
rows.limits: Arbitrary mathematical equivalence and instructional scope are independently judged, not proved by string equality.

rows.area: Independent source-first interpretation and pre-author exemplar acceptance
rows.verification: Adversarial gates require both original accounts, mandatory handoffs and exact three-anchor native/paired-UI/semantic evidence before author admission. Source/policy changes start uncontaminated source-only thread. Optional donor follows saved target account; verifier remains same role through exemplar and final verification.
rows.limits: Source account and pedagogical judgments remain fallible; this enforces order, independence and inspectable evidence rather than declaring accounts true.

rows.area: Material input and instruction cache integrity
rows.verification: Changed target/reference/account, exemplar image bytes for list/wrapper, linked instructions, source-only image closure invalidate affected work; inventory-only churn preserves reuse. Stale result/input revisions archived; retry counters retained.
rows.limits: Completed approvals are deliberately preserved; unfinished work gains the new phase gates after exact pending-publication recovery.

rows.verification: 45 targeted tests passed. Positive hard/quartic exponentials, ordinary power/direct-log hard trig, inverse canonical fractional/ratio scaling, legitimate cancellation, smaller banks and filtered fragments admitted with independent math and old-failure checks. Five changed-constructor cases additionally passed native5-positive/5-wrong and20 actual player renders.
rows.limits: Bounded constructors retain scoped arithmetic/domain/workload limits with rationale; this is not a claim of full mathematical-domain or every-seed coverage.

rows.area: Recognized evidence binds final delivered work and current native runtime
rows.verification: Record/field-linked positives, meaningful wrong controls and applicable equivalents required; empty/unresolved/stale reports fail. Delivered records cannot borrow raw identities. Cargo-locked offline build embeds source identity and records compiler/linked artifacts. Screenshot bytes hashed. Active engine changes rerun affected checks.
rows.limits: Native acceptance does not prove mathematical correctness or pedagogical purpose. Historical completed approval is not expired by unrelated engine changes.

rows.area: Actual unanswered and completed learner views
rows.verification: Same representative requires paired active/completed states at same viewport; applicable narrow view required. Renderer records selection/omission. Live semantic reviewer actually viewed both graph controls; root inspected five actual changed-constructor player pairs at420px.
rows.limits: DOM/MathJax success alone is not readability. Long completed equations use existing horizontal scroll; actual visual judgment remains required.

rows.area: Retained behavior survives immutable packaging and refill filtering
rows.verification: New approvals require a reviewed applicability plan, every retained finding covered or justified, named checks on all actual survivors, normalized usable inventory records, isolated declared-file execution and relevant native controls. Integration test performs real three-band dedup before hooks; undeclared imports/data fail.
rows.limits: The verifier must judge applicability and checker meaning. Legacy approved packages retain documented fallback; this change does not retrofit immutable published packages.

rows.verification: Catalog exhaustion requires usable native-checked finite catalog; duplicate-only sampling is not exhaustion. Real finder emits content signals, supervisor reopens on teaching/answer/retirement changes while ignoring basis/learner-answer churn.
rows.limits: Content identities detect EDB source/pool edits; corruption of external immutable images under unchanged references is not a finder content event. Learner availability differs from catalog exhaustion.

rows.area: Supersede mistaken repairs without losing counterexamples
rows.verification: Explicit source-backed finding dispositions retain historical counterexamples; conceptual amendments bind runner-frozen initial account and source-valid neighbor. Live A+C and cancellation controls reject restrictions that merely satisfy a previous local repair.
rows.limits: No fourth reviewer added; corrected interpretation must still pass the same independent verifier gates.

rows.verification: Preserve all three bands, nonempty-checkbox/source-supported None policy, imported identities/history, runner-owned publication. Live independent-subset controls retain A+C without requiring an all-false checkbox case.
rows.limits: P13/D01 is deliberately preserved pending a product decision. D02 calibration uncertainty is documented; D03 duplicate faithful guide replaced with introduction/links.
